title: Bon Voyage
creator: Jean-Paul Rappeneau
description: A farce set in Bordeaux in June 1940, when the French government, politicians, and Parisian celebrities fled there ahead of the German army and crowded its grand hotels. With Isabelle Adjani and Gérard Depardieu. In French.

title: The Consul of Bordeaux
creator: João Correa & Francisco Manso
place: Statue of Aristides de Sousa Mendes
description: A drama about Aristides de Sousa Mendes, the Portuguese consul who issued visas to thousands of refugees in Bordeaux in June 1940 against his government’s orders. In Portuguese and French.

title: Mondovino
creator: Jonathan Nossiter
description: A documentary on the globalization of wine, from Bordeaux’s great châteaux and its star consultant Michel Rolland to small growers who resist. The Cité du Vin, a museum of wine, opened on the river in 2016.

title: Red Obsession
creator: David Roach & Warwick Ross
description: A documentary, narrated by Russell Crowe, on the rush by Chinese buyers for top Bordeaux wines around 2010, which drove prices to record highs, especially for Château Lafite in Pauillac.
